h1: Zambia tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Zambia? This page explains the Zambia tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Zambia tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders don't need a visa to visit Zambia for short stays. You'll still need a visa if you're going to work, or staying longer than visa-free entry allows.

sections.heading: What a Zambia tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Zambia tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Zambia. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Zambia business visa](/zambia-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents travelling on other passports may need a visa, depending on their nationality. Travellers who do need a visa can ask us about the KAZA visa, which has covered both Zambia and Zimbabwe.

sections.heading: Zambia tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Zambia tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Zambia.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Zambia tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Zambia tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Zambia on a Zambia tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Zambia tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
